release_notes:
- Audio settings update the volume and mic keys already on the device. A missing key is reported instead of being created.
- Read Device Info also fills the Audio tab. Mic control names come from the PS-key definitions.
- Writing audio settings sends only the keys you changed, so settings written from another tab or by the headset are no longer reverted.
- Read buttons always read the device, so they show what the headset holds now.
- A device that resets after a write no longer triggers the "Device Switched" message or clears the tabs; only a device that stays disconnected for 6 seconds does.
- The info mark next to the volume labels is smaller and shows its note on click.
